questions.q: How old was the Ghulam (boy) in this story?
questions.explain: The Ghulam was a boy of about 12 or 13.

questions.q: Who taught the Ghulam to worship only Allah?
options: The monk, a follower of Prophet Isa AS
questions.explain: The monk was a follower of Prophet Isa AS who taught the Ghulam tawhid.

questions.q: How did the Ghulam kill the giant beast blocking the road?
options: He shot it with an arrow
He threw a stone while praying to Allah
questions.explain: The Ghulam threw a stone while praying, and the beast died.

questions.q: Who could see again after the Ghulam prayed?
questions.explain: The blind minister believed, then the Ghulam prayed and he could see.

questions.q: What did the Ghulam say when the minister offered him gifts for curing him?
options: He was afraid of the king
He cannot cure anyone, it is Allah who cures
questions.explain: The Ghulam refused the gifts and made clear that Allah is the one who cures.

questions.q: How was the Ghulam finally killed by the king?
options: Shot with an arrow while saying the name of the Ghulam's Lord
questions.explain: The Ghulam himself taught the king to shoot him while saying the name of the Ghulam's Lord, and the people believed.

questions.q: Which surah records the story of the People of the Trench?
questions.explain: The story of those killed in the trench is mentioned in Surah Al-Buruj.

questions.q: The monk and the minister were killed because they would not give up their faith.
questions.explain: True. The king killed them both because they refused to give up their faith.

questions.q: The Ghulam wanted to become famous, rich and a king.
questions.explain: False. The Ghulam did not want fame, wealth or a throne. He wanted everyone to embrace Islam and enter Paradise.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: The king shoots the Ghulam saying the name of Allah
The king digs the fiery trench
The blind minister is cured and believes
The monk and the minister are killed

questions.explain: The Ghulam met the monk, the minister was cured, the monk and minister were killed, the Ghulam was shot, and finally the fiery trench was dug.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The people killed in the trench
Knowledge taught by shaytan, used to deceive
A religious teacher who withdraws to pray and teach

questions.explain: A ghulam is a young boy, a rahib is a religious teacher, sihr is knowledge from shaytan, and Ashabul Ukhdud are the people killed in the trench.

questions.q: You are good at drawing. Based on the story of the Ghulam, what can you do with that skill?
options: Use it to invite people to Allah
Stop because you fear being tested
questions.explain: The Ghulam used his ability to call people to Allah. Other skills can be used the same way.
